text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot is one seed's mean CRPS over all 8 refit months. The three seeds that experiment 695 fitted score about 0.08 points better than the seven fitted here, for A0 alone; S1 and SP score the same in both groups.'
text.tspan: Each dot is one seed's mean CRPS over all 8 refit months. The three seeds that
experiment 695 fitted score about 0.08 points better than the seven fitted here,
for A0 alone; S1 and SP score the same in both groups.
